stem: Which statement best reflects nutrient availability?
choices: If nutrient concentration is high enough in solution, uptake is guaranteed.
A high total EC reveals which individual nutrients are present and available.
pH mainly affects meter readings and has little relationship to nutrient chemistry.
A nutrient can be present in solution yet remain poorly available because pH, water status, ion interactions, and root health affect uptake.
rationale: Supply and availability are not the same thing. A nutrient may be present in the solution but still be poorly taken up because of pH, root-zone water status, ionic interactions, oxygen conditions, or root health. This is why neither concentration nor EC alone proves that the plant can access a specific nutrient.
